WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_budget, b.event_status, AVG(e.cost) AS group_avg
  FROM expense AS e
  JOIN budget AS b ON CAST(b.budget_id AS TEXT) = CAST(e.link_to_budget AS TEXT)
  GROUP BY e.link_to_budget, b.event_status
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_group_avgs
  FROM group_avgs
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.event_status, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.avg_of_group_avgs AS diff
  FROM group_avgs AS g
  JOIN overall_avg AS o ON o.avg_of_group_avgs IS NOT NULL
  WHERE g.group_avg > o.avg_of_group_avgs
)
SELECT event_status, AVG(group_avg), AVG(diff)
FROM kept
GROUP BY event_status
